name: Mayonnaise (Vegan)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Drain the tofu and blend in a food processor/blender until smooth.
Add the oil slowly and gradually to the blended tofu while the blender is still running. This emulsifies the mixture.
Add additional spices (e.g. salt, black pepper, etc.) to taste.

culture.text: Mayonnaise, colloquially referred to as "mayo", is a thick, creamy sauce with a rich and tangy taste that is commonly used on sandwiches, hamburgers, bound salads, and French fries. It also forms the base for other sauces, including tartar sauce, fry sauce, remoulade, salsa golf, ranch dressing, and rouille.
